POWERFUL, RELIABLE AND STABLE
A strong partner for Mini ITX and compact gaming PCs
The SFX L Power supplies CPUs and GPUs with steady and dependable power thanks to a stable 12V-rail, high quality Japanese capacitors and innovative technologies such as LLC, Synchronous Rectifier and DC-to-DC conversion. 4 PCIe connectors to support multi-GPU setups.
QUIET OPERATION FOR COMPACT SYSTEMS
Optimized for low-noise operation
This PSU is perfect for compact gaming PC or HTPC users who are looking for an SFX PSU that is fitted with a 120mm fan. This model includes a temperature-controlled fan. The SFX L Power was built to be very silent thanks to the fan technology used and it produces little wasted heat.
80 PLUS® GOLD CERTIFICATION
Very high operating efficiency
SFX L Power 600W is certified 80 PLUS Gold with an efficiency rating of up to 92% – a truly outstanding level for this class of PSU. The most compelling benefit: lower power consumption and consequently lower costs with cooler and quieter operation.
MODULAR AND FLAT CABLES
Highly compatible and convenient
Entirely modular cables are enhanced by premium black flat cables. This simplifies the installation and keeps the system tidy.
SUPER VERSATILE INSTALLATION
Adapts to your individual requirements
This power supply is particularly versatile in deployment thanks to the SFX-to-ATX adapter bracket provided. Not only does it fit into cases with an SFX form factor, but can also be installed in a few simple steps into larger ATX cases.
“Users with mini ITX PCs or overall compact systems also deserve a quiet and powerful PSU with up to 80PLUS® Gold efficiency. With this in mind, we have developed the SFX Power series. To all whom it concerns: you are welcome.”
Christian Rex, Head of BU PSU
